fact: Communications minister Sam George said the ministry is developing a national data exchange hub intended to connect 48 government data registries.

The analyst says the Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations and NITA, under the World Bank-backed Ghana Digital Acceleration Project, are moving to operationalise a National Data Exchange Hub, described elsewhere as soon-to-be-established.

Communications minister Samuel Nartey George said on 2026-10-21 that the government is building a single national backbone, a national data exchange hub, to connect 48 public registries including the National Identification Authority, Ghana Statistical Service, Births and Deaths Registry and Ghana Police Service.

La Marina BJ reports that the launch of the CitizenApp Data Interoperability System in October 2024 marked a turning point in the integration of services and data exchange between administrations in Ghana.
